comments.author: CABlakeC
comments.body: From what I can gather this, along with the other Quintet Coat of the (____), were released on the Japanese server as part of a "Legendary Sounds Echoing in the Waves” live event that was in collaboration with a RL Japanese band called Zoorssiannbrass way back in 2015. Given the possible legal issues and the mediocre stats, it's pretty unlikely this will ever be released for us on Maris.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: I agree, it's very unlikely. Still... if we ask in support tickets, something could still happen. You never know until you try. Cheers.
